insights.one_liner: Relocately is a 20-person Amsterdam relocation platform founded in 2021, with offices on three continents and English-language marketing roles.

culture.text: About 20 people, headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Sydney, Singapore and Manila.
Calls its team diverse and global, with values like ambition, impact, judgement and doing more with less.
Staff backgrounds include international business and global studies, from schools like Esade, EADA and TU Delft.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its business is helping people relocate, including immigration services, across more than 70 countries.

growth.text: Founded in 2021; says it is expanding into new services like currency exchange, short-stay housing and immigration help.
